title: $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebras of small surfaces
summary: We study the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebras of small surfaces, focusing on the closed torus and the once-punctured torus. We provide explicit finite presentations by generators and relations for the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebra of the torus and once-punctured torus, analogous to those of Bullock and Przytycki for the Kauffman bracket skein algebras. We give explicit bases of the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein algebras of the torus and once-punctured torus and describe the multiplicative structure of the basis for the torus, analogous to the product-to-sum formula of Frohman and Gelca.
